This compound is then shown to target Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The second pathway involves Dalteparin targeting Guanine nucleotide-binding protein G(I)/G(S)/G(O) subunit gamma-2, which is targeted by n-acetyl serotonin, which in turn targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. Both pathways involve a chain of molecular interactions that ultimately lead to the targeting of the same protein. The integration of these pathways suggests that Dalteparin may exert its effects through multiple molecular mechanisms, potentially influencing the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 in a complex manner. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Dalteparin and the target protein, though the exact nature of the interactions and their functional implications remain to be fully elucidated.
